summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its preliminary, unaudited Production Sales Report for the third quarter of 2026, dated October 29, 2026. The disclosure is operational rather than transactional: Brazil ethylene utilization 69%, resins sales 854 kt, US/Europe PP spread $402/t, Mexico PE spread $921/t. The only structural item referenced is progress in Braskem Idesa's financial restructuring, described as a comprehensive consensual stakeholder agreement, but no terms, price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. This is a routine quarterly operating update, not a special situation; watch spreads and Idesa restructuring detail.
